ITEM 1 | Triangular wedge of flatbread-like crust, golden-tan with darker brown blistered spots, slightly crisp edges, sitting at top-right edge of plate, roughly 9 cm long by 5 cm wide, about 1.5 cm thick, light and porous looking | 60
ITEM 2 | Small rounded piece of medium-brown meat with smooth, slightly glossy surface and faint browned crust, dense and moist-looking, roughly 5 cm by 4 cm, about 2 cm thick, sitting beside the flatbread wedge on the right edge | 45
ITEM 3 | Bone-in piece with golden-brown, slightly shiny skin over lighter tan flesh, one end showing a pale exposed bone-like tip, roughly 9 cm by 5 cm, about 3 cm thick, positioned lower right of plate | 110
ITEM 4 | Adjacent smaller chunk of browned, slightly darker meat with fibrous, moist texture near the bone-in piece, roughly 4 cm by 3 cm, about 1.5 cm thick | 30
ITEM 5 | Pale yellow-tan rounded lump with slightly rough, matte surface and soft-looking texture, roughly 4 cm by 3 cm, partly tucked under the bone-in piece on the lower right | 35
ITEM 6 | Scattered small bits of yellow-green crumb and flecks on the white tablecloth just off the plate's left and bottom edges, dry and crumbly, each under 1 cm | 3
